about: Daonil 5 mg (glibenclamide) is supplied nine times and appears by brand name only.
Glibenclamide 5 mg is supplied three times in the middle of a 15-month history while metformin is supplied throughout.
Diamicron MR (gliclazide) is supplied with metformin. Gliclazide is another sulfonylurea but is not glibenclamide, so it must not flag.
